overview.description: The Bluemonte Dynamic Total Market ETF (BLUX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is a fund-of-funds with broad exposure to the US equity total market. It is an actively managed portfolio utilizing a top-down and bottom-up approach to security selection. BLUX was launched on Jun 20, 2025 and is issued by Bluemonte.
